headline: Discussion of a Purchasing Ordinance, leasing of town owned property, and street and sidewalk ordinances.
summary: The Ordinance Committee will discuss a Purchasing Ordinance, the possibility of an ordinance for leasing town owned property, and ordinances related to streets and sidewalks.
items: Discussion of Purchasing Ordinance - Councilor Laffin

Discussion of Streets and Sidewalks related Ordinance(s) - Legal/Police
